title: How to Clean a Fabric Sofa

seo.title: How to Clean a Fabric Sofa
seo.meta_description: Clean a fabric sofa by vacuuming first and reading its cleaning code; use minimal moisture on stains and dry quickly to prevent rings and odor.
seo.search_intent: Clean fabric upholstery without soaking it or using a product incompatible with its cleaning code, dyes, or cushion filling.

excerpt: The sofa label determines how much moisture you can use. Before reaching for water, foam, or an extractor, find the upholstery cleaning code and test a hidden area.
content_html:
Two sofas that look like the same fabric can require different care. The upholstery cleaning code and cushion construction set the method.

Vacuum before adding moisture

Remove loose cushions when possible and vacuum seams, folds, and the deck beneath them. Wetting dust and crumbs can turn them into grime.

Find the cleaning code

On common North American tags, W generally allows water-based products, S calls for solvent, WS allows either, and X limits cleaning to vacuuming or professional methods. Follow the actual manufacturer label on your furniture.

Test any cleaner in a hidden area

Check for dye transfer, texture change, or a ring before treating a visible stain. Put a small amount on the cloth rather than saturating the cushion.

Work from the stain edge inward

Blot instead of scrubbing sideways. Repeat with small amounts and remove cleaner residue as the product directs. Large stains may require treating a slightly wider controlled area to avoid a water line.

Drying is part of cleaning

Ventilate and stand cushions so air reaches multiple sides. Filling that stays damp for many hours can develop odor or mold.

Large stains, delicate upholstery, S/X codes, or valuable furniture are good reasons to use a qualified upholstery cleaner instead of continuing to add products.

faq.question: Can every fabric sofa be cleaned with water?
faq.answer: No. Check the cleaning code or manufacturer instructions before wetting the upholstery.

faq.question: Why did cleaning leave a ring?
faq.answer: Too much liquid, cleaner residue, or uneven moisture spread can create a visible boundary.

faq.question: Can I use a carpet extractor on the sofa?
faq.answer: Only if the fabric, filling, and manufacturer allow it and you can dry the sofa completely.
